text:
The nightly job failed because the server's disk hit 98% full, so there was no room to write its output. The root cause was that log rotation had been disabled back in January, and logs piled up until the disk ran out of space. Nobody's at fault; it slipped through.

We freed up 40 GB by clearing out the old logs, then reran the job. It completed successfully at 02:40.

Log rotation is back on, so this shouldn't happen again. We're also looking at adding a disk usage alert to catch it earlier next time.

Thanks for flagging it. If you want details on the cleanup or the alert setup, let me know.
